verdict.rationale: Penpot's own docs describe an API that apps can reach with access tokens and that exposes objects and properties for workflow automation. It also documents an open plugin API that its MCP server uses to let AI agents drive designs. However, the pack contains no API reference documentation, and probes for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec at the help site returned 404. That leaves how deep and how well documented the public API is unproven. missing for 10: published API reference/OpenAPI spec, documented endpoint coverage for creating and editing designs, independent or hands-on corroboration of driving Penpot via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Use access tokens as an alternative login authentication. They can allow an app to access Penpot's API.
Get extensive access to objects and properties to enable external rendering, workflow automation, enhanced app functionality, and more.
Penpot MCP server is agnostic and enables high-quality multi-directional AI workflows through our world-class open plugin API.
AI agents can easily read and interact with your design files creating high-fidelity artifacts.
